sources.finding: Desktop is available for macOS and beta Windows, imports Claude Code/Codex conversations into Cline, schedules tasks and supports own keys and local models. Importing a conversation does not run the original harness.

sources.title: Cline Cloud Agents
sources.locator: Run several agents; Phone; Saved work; Security; Limits
sources.finding: Cloud sessions work from mobile browsers and persist when the laptop closes. Each uses a separate sandbox and cline/ branch. Sandboxes pause after 15 idle minutes; limits are 10 simultaneous and 50 new sessions daily.

sources.title: Cline Agent Teams
sources.locator: Starting a Team; Resuming Team Work; Team State
sources.finding: SDK, CLI and Kanban teams use a coordinator, persistent shared task board, inter-agent mailbox and mission log in teams.db. Resume restores the team; IDE extensions do not support teams.

sources.title: Cline Subagents
sources.locator: How It Works; Approvals; Turning Subagents Off
sources.finding: CLI and Desktop subagents have separate context, run concurrently and return reports. Child usage rolls into session totals. Parent spawn approval covers all child tools, which do not request separate approvals.

sources.title: Cline CLI reference
sources.finding: CLI supports detached worktrees, headless JSON event/result output, optional task timeouts and HTML history export. Result records include usage, duration, iterations, model and finish reason.

sources.title: Memory Bank

sources.finding: An optional Markdown-file methodology preserves project requirements, architecture, current context and progress across conversations; it depends on configured instructions and updates.

sources.title: Cline Enterprise

sources.finding: Cline executes locally or on chosen remote hosts and supports direct provider endpoints. Member/Admin/Owner roles govern the organization. It has no repository indexing and provides OpenTelemetry usage export.

sources.finding: Telemetry defaults on. UI and telemetryOptOut controls disable reporting; Desktop/CLI need a hub restart for non-prompt events. Cline/ClinePass provider requests may include prompts and responses; other providers do not send prompt contents to Cline telemetry.

sources.finding: The open-source extension and CLI are free with no subscriptions or seat fees; users pay inference charges. Enterprise has custom pricing and centralized administration.
